capabilities: Edit Word documents with WYSIWYG formatting
Edit Excel and CSV/TSV spreadsheets with formulas
Edit and present PowerPoint slide decks
Autosave changes back to original files
extras: Desktop only; beta releases can be installed through BRAT; all processing is local with no cloud telemetry.
motivation: To bring a full office editing workflow into the knowledge vault without external applications or Markdown conversion.
problem: Obsidian cannot natively open or edit Office documents and PDFs, so users must switch to external applications.
summary: All-in-one editor for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV/TSV, and PDF files inside Obsidian.
